evidenceKinds.requirement: Invoke or observe the exact reachable surface identity on the bound restricted runtime and record its edge-specific result; presence-only retrieval cannot prove a callable.
Exercise the exact native lifecycle operation and its applicable wrong-thread, wrong-runtime, wrong-generation, wrong-profile, replay, replacement, or post-destroy refusal.
Bind the edge source identity to the generated restricted install plan and prove that no selected bootstrap, lazy installer, callback, resolver, alias, or retained closure installs it.
Probe every source-derived attacker reachability root for the exact edge and prove that the surface cannot be resolved or invoked after restricted bootstrap.

globalCorpora.requirement: Reject stale, mutated, wrong-format, wrong-engine, wrong-profile, and wrong-protected-object activation artifacts before code execution.
Pass missing, duplicate, malformed, oversized, throwing, replay, and post-poison activation/event cases on the bound exact engine.
Prove generic eval, module loaders, host bridges, CLI, debugger, inspector, and compatibility globals remain unreachable.
Reject full, diagnostic, and restricted Host/artifact confusion before engine allocation or JSI mutation.
Destroy the runtime and prove no callback, completion, event binding, Host context, timer, or native handle remains callable or reusable.

invalidRunRules: Any dirty source tree outside the report, attestation, and generated publication outputs invalidates the run.
Any source revision, tree, projection, fixture-plan, target, feature, or engine identity mismatch invalidates the run.
Any missing, duplicate, generic, stale, cross-target, or cross-profile per-edge observation invalidates the affected row.

Any process timeout, crash without an expected marker, truncated evidence artifact, or nonzero command exit invalidates that execution unless the fixture explicitly expects and binds that exact failure mode.
An invalid run may be repeated only with unchanged authorities and a fresh run identity; its failed artifact remains recorded and cannot be overwritten.
